How ordering works

Four simple steps. Your order is only placed once your advance payment is verified — that is what keeps prices low and delivery prepaid.

1

Pick a product

Choose any product below and tap “Order now”. Enter your name, phone, city and full address.

2

Pay in advance

Send the exact total to our Easypaisa account (or pay cash as arranged). If paying by Easypaisa, keep your transaction ID (TID).

3

Place your order

Login and place the order — for Easypaisa, add your transaction ID first. Your order is saved to your account instantly for verification.

4

Receive it prepaid

We verify your payment and dispatch your order to your address as prepaid. Check the item within 7 days.

Payment & guarantee

Clear rules, written down — so you know exactly where you stand before you pay.

Advance payment only

We accept Easypaisa or cash in advance. There is no Cash on Delivery (COD) — orders are placed only after payment is received and verified.

7-day check guarantee

After delivery you get 7 days to check your product. If it arrives damaged or faulty:

  • Message us on WhatsApp within 7 days
  • Send a photo or short video of the fault
  • We’ll arrange a replacement or refund under our guarantee

Prepaid delivery

Once your payment is verified, your order is dispatched to your address as a prepaid order. The courier will not ask you for any money at the door.

Common questions

Why is there no Cash on Delivery?

We prepare and dispatch each order only after your payment is verified, and we cover the delivery cost upfront ourselves. Advance payment keeps this possible and keeps prices honest — the parcel then reaches you already paid, with nothing to hand over at the door.

How do I pay with Easypaisa?

At checkout you’ll see our Easypaisa account number and the exact amount. Send that amount from your Easypaisa app, copy the transaction ID (TID) from the confirmation, paste it in the order form, and place your order here. We verify the TID, then dispatch your order — track it live in “My Orders”.

Can I pay cash instead?

Yes — choose “Cash” at checkout and place your order here (no transaction ID needed). We’ll confirm how to hand over the cash, and your order is dispatched once the cash is received.

How long does delivery take?

After payment verification we dispatch your order the same day. Delivery then typically takes a few working days depending on your city. Your live status and tracking number appear automatically in “My Orders”.

What if my product is damaged or faulty?

You’re covered by our 7-day check guarantee. Message us on WhatsApp within 7 days of delivery with a photo or video of the problem, and we’ll arrange a replacement or refund.

What happens if my payment can’t be verified?

We’ll contact you on WhatsApp to re-check the transaction ID. If no matching payment is found, the order simply isn’t placed — nothing is charged or shipped until verification succeeds.
